The nonlinear MLP mapper baseline is trained with these settings:

- **Optimizer:** Adam (p. 7, p. 17)
- **Learning rate:** 10⁻³ (p. 17)
- **Epochs:** 20 (p. 17)
- **Batch size:** 4,096 (p. 17)

It uses MSE loss, the same loss as the ridge mapper (p. 7, p. 17). One MLP is trained for each target layer, head, and K or V. Each has two 1,024-unit ReLU hidden layers: Linear(d_s, 1024) → ReLU → Linear(1024, 1024) → ReLU → Linear(1024, d_h^t) (p. 7, p. 17).
